Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one square photographic background for a portfolio card.
Input image: visual reference only. Match the relevant card's scene, framing and photographic lighting closely, but output ONE full-bleed photo with no UI.
Style: realistic cinematic photograph, midnight blue shadows with restrained warm amber light. Natural real-world locations, not science fiction.
Composition: square. Main scene occupies the upper 80% with natural scene detail extending to the bottom. No artificial black footer; the webpage will add a gradient.
Avoid: UI, borders, labels, captions, icons, watermark, readable text, science-fiction scenery, fantasy planets, electric sky clouds, huge luminous nebula.
Primary request: closely recreate the FIRST photo in the reference: modern long university building with warm illuminated glass windows, trees at the sides and wet reflective paths, evening/night. The building occupies most of the frame, sky is only the upper quarter. A subtle blue starry sky has a very faint hint of galactic haze, like the reference, not a giant nebula; stars are sparse and realistic. Low architectural angle.
